channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Marketing, TV e advocacia: onde Tarcísio e Haddad gastam na campanha
item.description: Campaign expenses for Tarcísio and Haddad for São Paulo governor are focused on digital marketing, advertising, TV and radio content production, and legal costs. Tarcísio leads with R$23 million in contracted expenses, of which R$12.2 million already paid, while Haddad accumulates R$12 million. Both face limits set by the TSE, with funds coming from donations and party funds.

item.title: Flávio é aconselhado a evitar novos anúncios de futura equipe de governo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's allies advise him to refrain from announcing future government team members, following backlash over Cláudio Lottenberg's appointment as Health Minister due to his criticism of Jair Bolsonaro's pandemic handling. The move aims to reduce campaign distractions and maintain focus on the direct race with Lula.

item.title: Fernando Diniz fala sobre fim do Corinthians na Libertadores e derrota em casa
item.description: Fernando Diniz commented on Corinthians' elimination from the Libertadores after a home loss to Estudiantes and emphasized the sadness of the fans. The coach highlighted the importance of bouncing back in the Brazilian Championship, where the team is in 13th place and at risk of relegation.

item.title: Método usado por Gilmar e Dino é o tumulto processual
item.description: The STF session was marked by criticism of Flávio Dino and Gilmar Mendes, accused of using procedural maneuvers to shield Alexandre de Moraes from investigations. While other justices advocated transparency, Dino and Gilmar were denounced for grandiose rhetoric and delaying tactics.

item.title: Supremo não cortará na carne
item.description: Despite proposals for Judiciary reform arising amid the crisis at the STF, it is unlikely the Supreme Court will move in that direction. The text suggests the STF may strike down initiatives without the backing of the justices.

item.title: Presidenciáveis já gastaram R$ 151 milhões na corrida pelo 1º turno
item.description: With 17 days until the first round of the 2026 presidential election, leading candidates have already spent R$151 million. Lula (PT) leads spending at R$65 million, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at R$55 million. The TSE spending cap allows up to R$88.9 million in the first round.

item.title: Crise no STF: campanha de Lula defende 'virar a página' da disputa entre Moraes e Mendonça
item.description: Following the STF session on the PF report that mentions Minister Alexandre de Moraes, Lula's campaign advocates 'turning the page' on the Moraes-Mendonça dispute, focusing on government comparisons and anti-Bolsonaro sentiment. The strategy aims to reduce Flávio Bolsonaro's appeal among independent voters.

item.title: Pressionado por crescimento de Flávio no Sudeste, Lula reforça agendas em Minas, Rio e São Paulo
item.description: Lula strengthens his presence in the Southeast to counter Flávio Bolsonaro's gains in polls, with events in Minas, Rio, and São Paulo. The region is crucial, holding over 40% of voters, where the PL candidate shows stronger performance.

item.title: Lula sugere que Corinthians venda Parque São Jorge para pagar Itaquera
item.description: President Lula suggested Corinthians sell the old Parque São Jorge to pay off debts with Caixa Econômica Federal. He criticized the interest rates charged to the club, noting that despite having repaid R$ 1.75 billion of an R$ 400 million loan, it still owes over R$ 600 million. The comment was made during a podcast appearance and reflects his concern over the club's financial struggles.

item.title: Governo prepara MP que pode atingir bets e patrocínios do futebol
item.description: The federal government is preparing a Provisional Measure that may ban online games and restrict sports betting, impacting million-dollar contracts of football clubs like Flamengo, Corinthians, Palmeiras and São Paulo. The measure, defended by Lula against gambling addiction, could result in a loss of R$1 billion in sponsorships for Brazilian football.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro usou em campanha imóvel de advogado alvo de buscas da PF no caso INSS, diz revista
item.description: The magazine Piauí reported that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro used an apartment linked to lawyer Willer Tomaz, who is under investigation in the Sem Desconto operation regarding INSS fraud. The property was also tied to Fabiano Zettel, nephew of Daniel Vorcaro, and Flávio allegedly used it to meet with campaign staff and record videos. Flávio has not officially commented on the matter.

item.title: Lula diz que não dará dinheiro ao BRB e chama Celina de cínica
item.description: At a campaign rally in Ceilândia, President Lula stated that the federal government will not use funds to bail out the BRB while maintaining Bolsa Família payments, and criticized DF Governor Celina Leão for trying to shift blame for the banking crisis. Lula emphasized the discovery of R$12 billion in fake securities purchased by the Bank of Brasília and held Banco Master executives and former governor Ibaneis Rocha accountable. He rejected a US$6.6 billion loan request backed by the federal government to cover BRB losses.

item.title: Internautas compartilham quiz “qual ministro do STF você é”
item.description: A humorous online quiz went viral after a Supreme Court session, matching users to the 10 justices’ personalities. It features 8 quick questions, no registration. A second arcade-style fighting game was also created with the justices as characters.

item.title: Crise no STF se soma a morosidade na Justiça e supersalários em desafios para próximo presidente
item.description: The ongoing crisis at the STF (Supreme Federal Court), judicial delays, and ministers' high salaries pose institutional challenges for the next president, directly affecting citizens' daily lives. Slow case processing and declining public trust in the judiciary deepen instability for the Executive Branch. These issues dominate national debates with significant implications for public administration and law enforcement.

item.title: Sob desgaste, Fachin tende a adiar caso Mendonça enquanto ministros discutem obstruir pauta do STF
item.description: Amid the fallout from the Master leak crisis, STF President Edson Fachin is likely to postpone the review of allegations of abuse of authority against Minister André Mendonça. The move comes as justices consider ways to prevent the case from dominating the court’s agenda.

item.title: Lula diz a aliados que sessão do STF foi um show de horrores e que vai procurar Fachin para conversa
item.description: President Lula criticizes the STF session, calling it a 'horror show,' and announces he will seek a conversation with Judge Fachin regarding the Moraes case. The session was marked by heated exchanges between judges and the suspension of the debate on the investigation against Alexandre de Moraes in the Master case.

item.title: Lula ataca Celina Leão no DF e diz que não vai dar dinheiro ao BRB: 'Quem quebrou foi a ligação do Vorcaro com Ibaneis'
item.description: Lula attacked Celina Leão in the DF, saying he will not inject funds into the BRB and blames the connection between Ibaneis and Vorcaro for the bank's crisis. He also criticized the minimum wage and warned about possible Trump interference in Brazilian elections.

item.title: Lula pode se encontrar com Zohran Mamdani, prefeito de Nova York, nos EUA
item.description: President Lula is scheduled to travel to New York for the 81st UN General Assembly, where he may meet with Mayor Zohran Mamdani, the first Muslim to hold the position. The meeting has not yet been officially confirmed by the Brazilian government. Lula intends to speak on UN reform, multilateralism, and international cooperation.

item.title: Brasil não comporta político que “fica de 4” para os EUA, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula sharply criticized Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro, accusing them of plotting against Brazil and prioritizing foreign interests, especially those of the US. He also attacked PEC 3/2022, denying it proposed beach privatization. Lula held a rally in Brasília, strengthening his support base in the Federal District.

item.title: Governo Lula rebate gestão Trump e diz que proposta de cooperação contra crime segue ignorada
item.description: President Lula's administration rejects U.S. criticism over combating transnational crime and states it is still awaiting a response to the cooperation proposal handed over in May 2026, which was disregarded by the Trump administration.

item.title: Botafogo vence o Grêmio em jogo quente e com cinco gols pelo Brasileirão
item.description: Botafogo defeated Grêmio 3-2 at Nilton Santos in a heated match with five goals, moving further away from the relegation zone in the Brazilian Championship. Danilo (two goals) and Montoro scored for the home team, while Jovane Cabral and Gustavo Martins netted for the visiting side.

item.title: Renan Santos inicia “Futuro Glorioso Tour” de ônibus pelo Sul e Sudeste
item.description: Renan Santos launched the 'Futuro Glorioso Tour', a bus caravan traveling through Southern and Southeastern cities until the Globo presidential debate. The route includes stops in Londrina, Maringá, Cascavel, Chapecó, Passo Fundo, and Porto Alegre, reinforcing his campaign with the 'Glorious Future' slogan. The tour aims to increase direct contact with voters as part of a pre-debate mobilization strategy.

item.title: Lula pede a brasiliense para não votar em Michelle ao Senado e volta a falar de Trump
item.description: Lula urged Brasília voters not to elect right-wing Senate candidates — including Michelle Bolsonaro and Bia Kicis — while accusing Eduardo Bolsonaro of trying to get Donald Trump to interfere in Brazil's election.

item.title: A nova pesquisa sobre a eleição presidencial no maior colégio eleitoral da região Centro-Oeste
item.description: A new electoral poll will measure the race between Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flavio Bolsonaro (PL) in Goias, the largest electoral college in the Central-West region of Brazil. Registered with the TSE under number BR-04652/2026, the Real Time Big Data survey is scheduled for release on September 22, following data collection between September 17 and 21, with 1,600 interviews and a maximum margin of error of 2 percentage points.

item.title: Lula diz que país não aceita 'político vira-lata que fica de quatro para os EUA'
item.description: At a rally in Ceilândia, Lula criticized candidates who act like stray dogs toward the US, reinforcing a national independence and anti-imperialist stance. He argued that Brazil does not accept politicians subordinated to foreign interests.

item.title: Lula pede voto para Zé Dirceu à Câmara dos Deputados e fala em 'reparação histórica'
item.description: President Lula recorded a video endorsing Zé Dirceu for the Chamber of Deputies and emphasized 'historical reparation' for the former Chief of Staff. The post was published on Dirceu's Instagram account during the 2026 election cycle.

item.title: Lula: quem quebrou o BRB foi ligação entre Ibaneis e Vorcaro; não vamos dar dinheiro para o BRB
item.description: President Lula accused former DF governor Ibaneis Rocha of harming Banco de Brasília (BRB) due to his connection with Daniel Vorcaro, ex-owner of Banco Master, during a rally in Ceilândia. Lula stated he will not allocate funds to BRB, reinforcing criticism of the prior administration.

item.title: TSE proíbe Lucas Bove de usar santinhos com imagem de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court issued a preliminary injunction prohibiting Lucas Bove (PL-SP) from using campaign leaflets featuring the image of Jair Bolsonaro. The ban was decided on Wednesday, 16th, and the space remains open for the candidate's manifestation.

item.title: Lula chama governadora do DF de cínica e diz que governo federal não vai dar dinheiro para o BRB
item.description: President Lula called the DF governor, Celina Leão, cynical and stated that the federal government will not provide funds for the financial recovery of Banco de Brasília.

item.title: A reação do governo Lula às críticas de Trump sobre combate ao PCC e ao CV
item.description: The Brazilian government, through the Ministry of Justice, rejected criticisms from U.S. President Donald Trump, asserting that Brazil has effectively combated organized crime, citing laws like the Anti-Gang Law and joint operations. Trump labeled the PCC and Red Command as global threats and demanded stronger actions, but Brazil highlighted existing international cooperation and initiatives such as the Brazil Against Organized Crime Program.

item.title: "Bolsonara de Ceilândia", diz Janja ao criticar candidatura de Michelle
item.description: Janja criticized Michelle Bolsonaro's candidacy, urging voters to avoid supporting people with the Bolsonaro surname. The event in Ceilândia featured Lula and Leandro Grass, who highlighted federal government actions in the Federal District.

item.title: "Lula é o presidente do DF", diz Grass em ato do PT em Ceilândia
item.description: Leandro Grass (PT), candidate for GDF, spoke at an event in Ceilândia with Lula, highlighting projects such as the metro, University of Brasília and new campuses. Lula asked for votes for Grass during his speech.

item.title: Governo Lula rebate e diz que EUA ignora medidas do Brasil contra o crime organizado
item.description: The Brazilian government pushed back against U.S. criticism over its alleged failure to combat the PCC and Red Command, highlighting measures such as the Anti-Gang Law and joint security operations. The Trump administration labeled the gangs as terrorists and accused Brazil of negligence, but Brasília emphasized international cooperation and sovereignty in security actions. President Lula seeks to maintain alignment with Washington despite disagreements on security strategies.

item.title: Lula diz que país não comporta político vira-lata que fica de 4 para os EUA
item.description: Lula stated, at an event in Ceilândia, that Brazil does not tolerate politicians who side with the US over national sovereignty, specifically calling Eduardo Bolsonaro a traitor. He also announced plans to travel to the US for the UN and discuss non-interference in Brazilian elections with Trump.

item.title: Em Ceilândia, apoiadores deixam ato de Lula antes de discurso por chuva
item.description: Lula's supporters left the Ceilândia event before his speech due to rain and fatigue from waiting. The event, scheduled for 19:00, only started around 20:00 with the speech beginning at 21:10.

item.title: 'Não vamos deixar o povo sem dinheiro, mas não vamos dar dinheiro para o BRB', diz Lula em evento de campanha
item.description: Lula stated that the federal government will not fund the BRB, claiming the bank purchased non-existent titles and that the crisis was caused by the link between Ibaneis Rocha and Daniel Vorcaro. He strongly criticized DF Governor Celina Leão, accusing her of trying to shift responsibility for the Banco de Brasília collapse. In his first official campaign rally in the capital, the president reiterated the federal government's stance of not providing guarantees for resolving the issue.

item.title: 'De dia mostra a bandeira nacional e de noite vai ficar de quatro para os EUA', diz Lula sobre Eduardo e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula labeled Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro as flip-flopping politicians, accusing the expelled brother of plotting against Brazil in the US and pressuring Trump not to interfere in Brazilian elections.

item.title: Veja como foi a quarta-feira (16) dos presidenciáveis
item.description: On Wednesday (16), presidential candidates carried out campaign activities such as rallies, leafleting, and podcast interviews, focusing on topics like logistics infrastructure, sanitation, and education. Candidates like Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula, and Hertz Dias had public schedules, while others, such as Rui Costa Pimenta and Clariana Barão, did not disclose engagements.

item.title: Lula pede voto para Zé Dirceu à Câmara dos Deputados e fala em ‘reparação histórica’
item.description: President Lula recorded a video endorsing Zé Dirceu, a former minister convicted in the Mensalão case, calling for 'historical reparation'. He highlighted Dirceu's health struggles, mentioning his recovery from cancer, and reaffirmed PT's support for the candidate running for the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Janja critica bolsonarismo e afirma: “Não vamos voltar para as trevas”
item.description: Janja Lula da Silva criticized Bolsonarism during a PT event in Ceilândia, warning against social backsliding. She emphasized the need to avoid returning to governments that, she claims, led the country into "darkness" and cited Michelle Bolsonaro as an example of alignment with conservative ideas. The speech took place amid intensified electoral campaigning.

item.title: Quais as assessorias de visto americano mais bem avaliadas?
item.description: A survey dated September 16, 2026 ranked U.S. visa assistance services in Brazil based on public ratings and review volume on Google, with a minimum score of 4.9. Viaggi Vistos topped the list with a 5.0 rating and 4,947 reviews, followed by Prime Vistos, Visto Vila Mariana, NOW Vistos, and Faustino Vistos.

item.title: Vorcaro “comprou os dois lados da polarização”, diz Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD presidential candidate, accused former banker Daniel Vorcaro of 'buying both sides of the polarization' in Brazil. Caiado claimed Vorcaro expects to be released if either Lula (PT) or Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) wins the election, implying he manipulated public opinion for personal gain. The statement was made on October 16th.

item.title: Governo instala conselho de minerais críticos e prepara 1ª reunião
item.description: President Lula established CIMCE, a council that will define Brazil's policy for critical and strategic minerals, with its first meeting scheduled within the next 10 days. The body includes representatives from 13 ministries and entities, and will have authority to assess strategic operations, ensuring national sovereignty over mineral resources. The creation of the National Policy for Critical and Strategic Minerals and the FGAM, with R$2 billion from the federal government, strengthens government control over the sector.

item.title: Em resposta aos EUA, governo brasileiro nega falhas no combate ao crime organizado
item.description: The Brazilian government denied any failures in combating organized crime following U.S. accusations, citing measures such as the Anti-Gang Law and the Brazil Against Organized Crime Program.

item.title: OAB e entidades de juízes e de procuradores criticam fala de Dino sobre corrupção no Judiciário
item.description: The OAB, ANPR, and judicial entities criticized Minister Flávio Dino's remarks about corruption in the judiciary made during a session at the STF.

item.title: Pai de Vorcaro pede revogação da prisão e que Fachin destrave processo no STF
item.description: The defense of Henrique Vorcaro requests the revocation of preventive detention and asks Minister Edson Fachin to move forward with the cases at the STF. Henrique has been detained for over 90 days suspected of belonging to a violent nucleus linked to Daniel Vorcaro's criminal group. The processing of the Master and INSS cases was suspended while the Court defines jurisdiction and rapporteur.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral proíbe propaganda de André do Prado que usa imagem de Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo's electoral court banned the rerun of an André do Prado (PL) ad featuring Tarcísio's image, imposing a $10,000 fine per broadcast. The ruling aims to prevent misuse of another politician's image during free electoral airtime.

item.title: Lula diz que governo gastou R$ 47 bi para conter alta de combustíveis
item.description: President Lula stated in a podcast that the federal government allocated R$47 billion to curb gasoline and diesel price hikes, blaming inflationary pressure on the Iran conflict. He noted the funds could have funded other priorities and criticized foreign interventions, such as Trump's, for harming Brazil's economy.

item.title: TSE vai enviar alertas no e-Título com orientações para eleições
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has begun sending notifications through the e-Título app to guide voters on electoral services and combat misinformation, providing details on polling locations and features such as certificates and fine payments. The free app replaces the physical voter ID and can serve as identification on election day for users with registered biometrics.

item.title: TSE proíbe candidato de utilizar imagem de Bolsonaro em santinhos
item.description: TSE minister Estela Aranha banned Lucas Bove's campaign, from PL, from using Jair Bolsonaro's image in campaign materials, enforcing a Supreme Court decision. The measure aims to prevent irregular political support, suspending the material's distribution until TSE plenary reviews the case.
